Subject: Pemberly Plumbing Services - Referral Required

Hi Celia,

Thanks for the submission on Pemberly Plumbing Services. I've reviewed the information and everything looks complete—appreciate the thorough package!

However, this falls into our contractor class, which requires underwriting management review before I can provide terms. I'd like to get some additional details to help move this along:

- What specific plumbing services do they perform (residential, commercial, new construction, service/repair)?
- Any work involving high-rise buildings or underground utilities?
- What's their largest typical project size?
- Current carrier and expiring premium?

I'll escalate this internally once I have these answers. If timing is tight, you might also consider reaching out to a contractor specialist that can quote this immediately.

Thanks,
[Underwriter name]
